basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Systems Engineer & Technical Project Manager | Agile & AI Delivery
basics.summary: Systems Engineer certified by the PMI in PMP® Fundamentals and CPMAI™, offering 7+ years of professional technology experience orchestrating critical software delivery across hyper-scale tech (MercadoLibre), fintech startups (Mo Technologies), and multinational banking (Scotiabank). Combines deep technical fluency in modern software engineering (distributed microservices, cloud APIs, testing frameworks) with strategic project delivery: orchestrating end-to-end SDLC from requirements to certified releases, establishing rigorous QA strategies and DoR/DoD quality gates, automating executive KPI dashboards in Power BI, and embedding generative AI frameworks to accelerate Time-to-Market with clear, predictable timelines. Bridges business goals and engineering execution to ensure frictionless, zero-defect production releases.

work.name: MercadoLibre
work.summary: High-volume distributed microservices platform requiring end-to-end SDLC ownership, test certification, and predictable release cycles.
highlights: Led agile squad execution under Scrum/Kanban across high-throughput distributed microservices; implemented Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria, increasing sprint delivery predictability by 20% with zero-defect production rollouts.
Partnered with engineering and QA to establish automated test suites (unit, integration, regression), reducing critical pre-release defects and ensuring certified, reliable software deployments.
Aligned regional engineering, product, and QA stakeholders; actively eliminated cross-team blockers and managed technical dependencies to guarantee on-time, predictable sprint schedules.
Architected and deployed generative AI operational workflows (Cursor, Claude, CPMAI™), accelerating code reviews, documentation, and test scenario creation by 30%.

work.name: Mo Technologies
work.summary: Directed end-to-end software delivery and quality assurance across a high-growth B2B fintech startup. Orchestrated cross-functional collaboration between engineering, QA, and product to deliver digital credit APIs and cloud integrations (Python/AWS) on strict timelines.
highlights: Orchestrated cross-functional collaboration between engineering, QA, and product to deliver digital credit APIs and cloud integrations (Python/AWS) on strict timelines.

Established automated testing standards and rigorous acceptance criteria that reduced post-deployment rework by 25%, while maintaining 99%+ platform availability and meeting SLA commitments with international banking partners.

work.name: Scotiabank GBS
work.position: System Access Analyst — IT Governance & Reporting
work.summary: IT governance, automated compliance reporting, and executive business intelligence dashboard development for a global financial institution.
highlights: Executive KPI Dashboards: Architected and automated interactive Power BI dashboards and Microsoft 365 reporting pipelines, providing bank leadership and audit committees with real-time operational visibility.

IT Governance & Compliance: Administered corporate identity and access governance (IAM) across enterprise Active Directory environments, upholding regulatory standards with zero compliance discrepancies.

Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Authored standardized bilingual documentation and operating manuals for onboarding enterprise applications (.NET ecosystem), boosting audit readiness across global operations.
